checks.detail: G01-G04 contracts, adapters, services, workflows and Registry checks pass.
Generated Mandarin fixture traversed the local adapter with explicit timing and speaker cluster.
No legal multi-series Development/Validation/Frozen Test labels for CER, entity CER, timestamp, DER/JER and severe slices.
FunASR model weights lack a complete checkpoint checksum, exact model-card license record and commercial approval.
A real demo frame traversed local OpenCV decode, candidate and quality transport.
OCR, semantic detection, tracking, identity candidates, embedding and VLM have no admitted checkpoint or domain threshold.

Long-video concurrent probe ran (2026-08-16): frozen_test 12 eps / 48 frames / 96 calls, 2 concurrent workers, 0 errors, OCR P50 8.0s DET P50 1.64s, peak RSS 2.7GB (engineering evidence; acceptance targets pending owner approval).
E03 proves generic Temporal restart, but exact Speech/Visual Activities have not completed kill/restart/idempotency acceptance.
No end-to-end P50/P95, RAM/Metal/disk, throughput and per-media-minute cost baseline exists.
Confidence remains Shadow, Automation remains L1, and E06 creates no Fact or Story.
Provider shadow/canary/rollback configuration is fail-closed and requires approved Provider Packages.
Dashboard definition and incident/recovery runbook are versioned; production telemetry wiring remains part of deployment qualification.
